Settings.Title: Settings
Settings.Language.Tooltip:
Show the framework's translated menus (MCM Mod Configs and plugin menus) in this language instead of the game's.
Only languages you have translation files installed for are listed.
Takes effect after a game restart. Non-Latin scripts also need the matching font enabled below.
Settings.PauseButtonPos.Tooltip:
Where the F4SE FRAMEWORK entry appears in the pause menu list.
Takes effect the next time the pause menu opens.
Settings.MCMCompat.Enable.Tooltip:
Translates installed MCM mod configs into F4SE Menu pages.
Requires game restart to take effect when toggled.
Settings.MCMCompat.RestartBody1: The MCM compatibility layer scans and translates MCM mod configs during game startup.
Settings.MCMCompat.RestartBody2: Restart the game for the MCM Mod Configs (Legacy) pages to appear.
Settings.MCMCompat.LoadLegacy: Load MCM Mod Configs (Legacy) Even With MCM Installed
Settings.MCMCompat.LoadLegacy.Tooltip:
The original MCM plugin is installed. By default this framework
also shows its own MCM Mod Configs (Legacy) pages alongside it
(both write the same setting files; hotkey actions only fire once).
Disable to let the original MCM be the only settings UI.
Requires game restart to take effect.
Settings.MCMCompat.ShowEditor: Always Show "Edit Categories" (with MCM Categorizer installed)
Settings.MCMCompat.ShowEditor.Tooltip:
The native category editor is the same tool the MCM Categorizer
page opens, so it is hidden by default while that mod is installed.
Turn on to show "Edit Categories" at the top of the list too.
With the MCM Categorizer mod removed it always shows.
Settings.Gamepad.GlyphStyle.Tooltip: Which controller button art the hint bar uses.
Settings.Gamepad.DisableKeyboard: Disable Keyboard Input While Using Gamepad
Settings.Gamepad.DisableKeyboard.Tooltip:
While a controller is connected, the menu ignores keyboard input so
stray key events can't fight controller navigation.
Setting a keybind still reads the keyboard, and the menu
toggle key and ESC (close menu) keep working.
